vb_textbox.text: The colour of the hats does not matter. What matters is the shape of the hat. At the start always choose the thinner, taller hat until it gives you a low number of mushrooms. By low number of mushrooms i mean 2 or 3. When it gives you a low number of mushrooms, change to the shorter, flatter hat and stick with it until that also starts giving you a low number of mushrooms, then change to the other hat and so on.
